A ValueError, like the simulator's own rejections.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass McpTools:\n    \"\"\"The five public methods, each a blocking MCP tool call.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, client: Client, loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:\n        self._client = client\n        self._loop = loop\n\n    def _call(self, tool: str, arguments: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:\n        future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self._client.call_tool(tool, arguments), self._loop)\n        result = future.result()\n        text = \"\".join(getattr(block, \"text\", \"\") for block in result.content)\n        if result.is_error:\n            raise RemoteToolError(text)\n        return json.loads(text)\n\n    def rules(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"rules\", {})\n\n    def map(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"map\", {})\n\n    def telemetry_log(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        return self._call(\"telemetry_log\", {})\n\n    def uplink(self, commands: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        return self._call(\"uplink\", {\"commands\": commands})\n\n    def advance(self, ticks: int = 1) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return self._call(\"advance\", {\"ticks\": ticks})\n\n    def tool_names(self) -> List[str]:\n        future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self._client.list_tools(), self._loop)\n        return [tool.name for tool in future.result().tools]\n\n\n@contextlib.contextmanager\ndef connect(target: Any) -> Iterator[McpTools]:\n    \"\"\"Open an MCP session on a background event loop and yield blocking tools.\"\"\"\n    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()\n    thread = threading.Thread(target=loop.run_forever, name=\"lightlag-mcp-client\", daemon=True)\n    thread.start()\n    ready: \"concurrent.futures.Future[Client]\" = concurrent.futures.Future()\n    stop_holder: List[asyncio.Event] = []\n\n    async def session() -> None:\n        # The session is opened and closed inside one task, as the SDK requires.\n        stop = asyncio.Event()\n        stop_holder.append(stop)\n        try:\n            async with Client(target) as client:\n                ready.set_result(client)\n                await stop.wait()\n        except BaseException as failure:\n            if not ready.done():\n                ready.set_exception(failure)\n                return\n            raise\n\n    running = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(session(), loop)\n    try:\n        client = ready.result(timeout=30)\n        try:\n            yield McpTools(client, loop)\n        finally:\n            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(stop_holder[0].set)\n            running.result(timeout=30)\n    finally:\n        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(loop.stop)\n        thread.join(timeout=5)\n        loop.close()","lineStart":1,"lineEnd":102,"totalLines":102,"truncated":false}},"title":"app/lightlag_client.py","time":{"start":1794709809981,"end":1794709809989}},"id":"prt_1dd0a6b38001balafcLR5zta31","sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","messageID":"msg_1dd0a06de00161ooQJ6EMJ0SXu"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794709894967,"sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"DWH0a9TyubIAw4eG","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/inspect_map.py","content":"import json\nimport math\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/app\")\nfrom lightlag_surface import Surface, PHYSICS\n\nprint(\"Python:\", sys.version)\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/map0.json\") as f:\n    world = json.load(f)\n\nsurf = Surface(world[\"cell_m\"], world[\"elevation_cm\"], world[\"terrain\"])\nbx, by = world[\"base\"]\nprint(\"Base:\", bx, by)\nprint(\"Sample target dict:\", world[\"targets\"][0])\n\ntotal_val = 0\nfor t in sorted(world[\"targets\"], key=lambda x: (x[\"deadline_tick\"] is None, x[\"deadline_tick\"] or 999, -x[\"value\"])):\n    total_val += t[\"value\"]\n    h, gx, gy, code = surf.sample(t[\"x\"], t[\"y\"])\n    sl = math.hypot(gx, gy)\n    dist_base = math.hypot(t[\"x\"] - bx, t[\"y\"] - by)\n    print(f\"  {t['id']:8s} pos=({t['x']:6.1f},{t['y']:6.1f}) val={t['value']} late={t['late_value']} dl={str(t['deadline_tick']):>4s} appear={t['appear_tick']} terr={code} slope={sl:.3f} h={h:6.2f} d_base={dist_base:5.1f}\")\nprint(f\"Total initial target value: {total_val}\")\n\n# ASCII map of steepness and targets (downsample 2x2 cells -> 60x40 chars)\ntarget_cells = {}\nfor idx, t in enumerate(world[\"targets\"]):\n    ci = int(t[\"x\"] // 10)\n    cj = int(t[\"y\"] // 10)\n    target_cells.setdefault((ci, cj), []).append(t)\n\nprint(\"\\nASCII Map (y from 400 down to 0, each char = 10x10m; #=steep>0.36, ^=slope>0.25, s=sand, k=rocks, .=regolith/bedrock, B=base, T/1-5=target):\")\nfor cj in range(39, -1, -1):\n    row_chars = []\n    for ci in range(60):\n        if int(bx // 10) == ci and int(by // 10) == cj:\n            row_chars.append(\"B\")\n            continue\n        if (ci, cj) in target_cells:\n            mv = max(t[\"value\"] for t in target_cells[(ci, cj)])\n            row_chars.append(str(int(mv)))\n            continue\n        # check the 4 5m cells inside\n        ms = 0.0\n        codes = []\n        for dj in (0, 1):\n            for di in (0, 1):\n                i, j = ci * 2 + di, cj * 2 + dj\n                ms = max(ms, surf.cell_max_slope(i, j))\n                codes.append(surf.codes[j][i])\n        if ms > 0.36:\n            row_chars.append(\"#\")\n        elif ms > 0.25:\n            row_chars.append(\"^\")\n        elif codes.count(\"s\") >= 2:\n            row_chars.append(\"~\")\n        elif codes.count(\"k\") >= 2:\n            row_chars.append(\":\")\n        else:\n            row_chars.append(\".\")\n    print(f\"{cj*10:3d} \" + \"\".join(row_chars))\nprint(\"    \" + \"\".join(str((ci // 6) % 10) if ci % 6 == 0 else \" \" for ci in range(60)))\nprint(\"    0     60    120   180   240   300   360   420   480   540\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/inspect_map.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/inspect_map.py","time":{"start":1794709894961,"end":1794709894966}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd0bb72d0018DtNEW4uBQPunE","sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","messageID":"msg_1dd0b4331001v75oFy1VFpEIjr"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794709947336,"sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"ZJKtuiykbDBcWm0l","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json\nimport math\nimport heapq\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/app\")\nfrom lightlag_surface import Surface, PHYSICS, TERRAIN_CODES\n\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/rules.json\") as f:\n    rules = json.load(f)\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/map0.json\") as f:\n    world = json.load(f)\n\nsurf = Surface(world[\"cell_m\"], world[\"elevation_cm\"], world[\"terrain\"])\nbx, by = world[\"base\"]\n\n# 1. Solar curve analysis\nfor eff in [0.8, 0.9, 1.0]:\n    tot = 0.0\n    for t in range(1, 421):\n        s = 2.8 * eff * math.sin(math.pi * (t + 56) / (420 + 112))\n        tot += s\n    print(f\"Solar eff={eff}: total_unclipped={tot:.1f}, t=1:{2.8*eff*math.sin(math.pi*57/532):.2f}, t=100:{2.8*eff*math.sin(math.pi*156/532):.2f}, t=210:{2.8*eff*math.sin(math.pi*266/532):.2f}, t=350:{2.8*eff*math.sin(math.pi*406/532):.2f}, t=420:{2.8*eff*math.sin(math.pi*476/532):.2f}\")\n\n# 2. High-res slope map around scarp and craters to find passes and travel times!\n# Let's build a 2.5m grid (241 x 161) or 2.0m grid (301 x 201) for A* / Dijkstra!\nstep_grid = 2.5\ngx_n = int(surf.width / step_grid) + 1   # 241\ngy_n = int(surf.height / step_grid) + 1  # 161\n\n# Check safety margin: rover has position uncertainty ~1-1.5m and heading noise ~1.5 deg (over 5m -> 0.13m).\n# Let's check what max_tilt buffer keeps paths connected!\nfor max_allowed_slope in [0.355, 0.33, 0.30]:\n    blocked = 0\n    for j in range(gy_n):\n        y = j * step_grid\n        for i in range(gx_n):\n            x = i * step_grid\n            if surf.slope(x, y) > max_allowed_slope:\n                blocked += 1\n    print(f\"Grid 2.5m ({gx_n}x{gy_n}={gx_n*gy_n}): blocked at slope>{max_allowed_slope} = {blocked}\")\n\n# Let's compute realistic tick-cost Dijkstra from Base and between all 38 targets!\n# With mid-range slip_base:\nslip_mid = {k: 0.5 * (v[0] + v[1]) for k, v in PHYSICS[\"slip_base_ranges\"].items()}\nprint(\"Mid slip_base:\", slip_mid)\n\ndef build_safety_grid(margin_m=2.0, max_slope=0.34):\n    # A node (i, j) at (x, y) is safe if all points within margin_m have slope <= max_slope\n    safe = [[True] * gx_n for _ in range(gy_n)]\n    offsets = [\n        (0.0, 0.0),\n        (margin_m, 0.0), (-margin_m, 0.0), (0.0, margin_m), (0.0, -margin_m),\n        (margin_m*0.7, margin_m*0.7), (margin_m*0.7, -margin_m*0.7),\n        (-margin_m*0.7, margin_m*0.7), (-margin_m*0.7, -margin_m*0.7),\n    ]\n    for j in range(gy_n):\n        y = j * step_grid\n        if y < 2.0 or y > surf.height - 2.0:\n            for i in range(gx_n):\n                safe[j][i] = False\n            continue\n        for i in range(gx_n):\n            x = i * step_grid\n            if x < 2.0 or x > surf.width - 2.0:\n                safe[j][i] = False\n                continue\n            ok = True\n            for dx, dy in offsets:\n                nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy\n                if not surf.inside(nx, ny) or surf.slope(nx, ny) > max_slope:\n                    ok = False\n                    break\n            safe[j][i] = ok\n    return safe\n\nsafe = build_safety_grid(margin_m=2.0, max_slope=0.34)\n\n# 16-neighborhood on 2.5m grid\nDIRS = []\nfor dj in range(-2, 3):\n    for di in range(-2, 3):\n        if di == 0 and dj == 0:\n            continue\n        if math.gcd(abs(di), abs(dj)) != 1:\n            continue\n        DIRS.append((di, dj, math.hypot(di * step_grid, dj * step_grid)))\n\ndef edge_ticks_and_energy(x1, y1, x2, y2):\n    # Approximate ticks (at 5.0 wheel_m per tick) and energy to go from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2)\n    dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1\n    dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)\n    ux, uy = dx / dist, dy / dist\n    mx, my = 0.5 * (x1 + x2), 0.5 * (y1 + y2)\n    h1, _, _, _ = surf.sample(x1, y1)\n    h2, _, _, _ = surf.sample(x2, y2)\n    hm, gx, gy, code = surf.sample(mx, my)\n    name = TERRAIN_CODES[code]\n    grade = gx * ux + gy * uy\n    slip = slip_mid[name] + PHYSICS[\"slip_grade_gain\"][name] * max(0.0, grade)\n    slip = min(0.90, max(0.0, slip))\n    # ground per 5.0m wheel = 5.0 * (1 - slip)\n    wheel_needed = dist / (1.0 - slip)\n    ticks = wheel_needed / 5.0\n    energy = wheel_needed * PHYSICS[\"drive_cost_per_wheel_m\"][name] + PHYSICS[\"climb_cost_per_m\"] * max(0.0, h2 - h1)\n    return ticks, energy\n\ndef dijkstra_from(sx, sy):\n    si, sj = round(sx / step_grid), round(sy / step_grid)\n    dist = [[1e9] * gx_n for _ in range(gy_n)]\n    ener = [[0.0] * gx_n for _ in range(gy_n)]\n    dist[sj][si] = 0.0\n    pq = [(0.0, si, sj)]\n    while pq:\n        d, i, j = heapq.heappop(pq)\n        if d > dist[j][i] + 1e-9:\n            continue\n        x1, y1 = i * step_grid, j * step_grid\n        for di, dj, _ in DIRS:\n            ni, nj = i + di, j + dj\n            if 0 <= ni < gx_n and 0 <= nj < gy_n and safe[nj][ni]:\n                # Also check midpoint safety for step > 1\n                if abs(di) == 2 or abs(dj) == 2:\n                    mi, mj = i + di // 2, j + dj // 2\n                    if not safe[mj][mi]:\n                        continue\n                x2, y2 = ni * step_grid, nj * step_grid\n                t_cost, e_cost = edge_ticks_and_energy(x1, y1, x2, y2)\n                nd = d + t_cost\n                if nd < dist[nj][ni]:\n                    dist[nj][ni] = nd\n                    ener[nj][ni] = ener[j][i] + e_cost\n                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, ni, nj))\n    return dist, ener\n\nimport time\nt0 = time.time()\nb_dist, b_ener = dijkstra_from(bx, by)\nprint(f\"Dijkstra from base took {time.time()-t0:.3f}s\")\n\nfor t in sorted(world[\"targets\"], key=lambda x: x[\"id\"]):\n    ti, tj = round(t[\"x\"] / step_grid), round(t[\"y\"] / step_grid)\n    print(f\"  {t['id']:4s} ({t['x']:5.1f},{t['y']:5.1f}) val={t['value']} dl={str(t['deadline_tick']):>4s} safe={safe[tj][ti]} ticks_from_base={b_dist[tj][ti]:5.1f} energy={b_ener[tj][ti]:5.1f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/analyze_world.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/analyze_world.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/analyze_world.py","time":{"start":1794709947331,"end":1794709947335}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd0c83c0001hLwrUUAbfkMaHq","sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","messageID":"msg_1dd0bcc70001ojnKcbxj5MO7hY"}}

json\nimport math\nimport heapq\nimport time\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/app\")\nfrom lightlag_surface import Surface, PHYSICS, TERRAIN_CODES\n\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/rules.json\") as f:\n    rules = json.load(f)\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/map0.json\") as f:\n    world = json.load(f)\n\nsurf = Surface(world[\"cell_m\"], world[\"elevation_cm\"], world[\"terrain\"])\nbx, by = world[\"base\"]\n\nstep_grid = 2.5\ngx_n = int(surf.width / step_grid) + 1   # 241\ngy_n = int(surf.height / step_grid) + 1  # 161\n\n# Let's check passability around the scarp (x ~ 130..240) to see where the scarp passes are!\nprint(\"Scarp profile (max slope in x=[125..245] for each y):\")\nfor y in range(0, 401, 10):\n    s_list = []\n    for x in range(120, 250, 5):\n        ms = surf.slope(x, y)\n        ch = \"#\" if ms > 0.34 else (\"^\" if ms > 0.25 else \".\")\n        s_list.append(ch)\n    print(f\"y={y:3d}: \" + \"\".join(s_list))\n\n# Build safety grid with margin=1.8m, max_slope=0.335 (very safe against max_tilt=0.36)\ndef build_safety_grid(margin_m=1.8, max_slope=0.335):\n    safe = [[True] * gx_n for _ in range(gy_n)]\n    # Check 17 points within margin_m\n    offsets = [(0.0, 0.0)]\n    for r in [margin_m * 0.5, margin_m]:\n        for k in range(8):\n            ang = k * math.pi / 4.0\n            offsets.append((r * math.cos(ang), r * math.sin(ang)))\n    for j in range(gy_n):\n        y = j * step_grid\n        if y < margin_m or y > surf.height - margin_m:\n            for i in range(gx_n):\n                safe[j][i] = False\n            continue\n        for i in range(gx_n):\n            x = i * step_grid\n            if x < margin_m or x > surf.width - margin_m:\n                safe[j][i] = False\n                continue\n            ok = True\n            for dx, dy in offsets:\n                nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy\n                if surf.slope(nx, ny) > max_slope:\n                    ok = False\n                    break\n            safe[j][i] = ok\n    return safe\n\nsafe = build_safety_grid(1.8, 0.335)\n\n# Precompute node height, gx, gy, code\nnode_h = [[0.0]*gx_n for _ in range(gy_n)]\nnode_gx = [[0.0]*gx_n for _ in range(gy_n)]\nnode_gy = [[0.0]*gx_n for _ in range(gy_n)]\nnode_terr = [[\"\"]*gx_n for _ in range(gy_n)]\nfor j in range(gy_n):\n    y = j * step_grid\n    for i in range(gx_n):\n        x = i * step_grid\n        h, gx, gy, code = surf.sample(x, y)\n        node_h[j][i] = h\n        node_gx[j][i] = gx\n        node_gy[j][i] = gy\n        node_terr[j][i] = TERRAIN_CODES[code]\n\nDIRS = []\nfor dj in range(-2, 3):\n    for di in range(-2, 3):\n        if di == 0 and dj == 0:\n            continue\n        if math.gcd(abs(di), abs(dj)) != 1:\n            continue\n        dist = math.hypot(di * step_grid, dj * step_grid)\n        DIRS.append((di, dj, dist, (di*step_grid)/dist, (dj*step_grid)/dist))\n\nslip_mid = {k: 0.5 * (v[0] + v[1]) for k, v in PHYSICS[\"slip_base_ranges\"].items()}\nslip_gain = PHYSICS[\"slip_grade_gain\"]\ndrive_cost = PHYSICS[\"drive_cost_per_wheel_m\"]\nclimb_cost = PHYSICS[\"climb_cost_per_m\"]\n\n# Precompute adjacency list for ultra-fast Dijkstra!\n# Each edge: (neighbor_idx, tick_cost, energy_cost)\n# Let's see how fast flat-array Dijkstra is in Python!\nN = gx_n * gy_n\nadj = [[] for _ in range(N)]\nfor j in range(gy_n):\n    for i in range(gx_n):\n        if not safe[j][i]:\n            continue\n        u = j * gx_n + i\n        h1 = node_h[j][i]\n        for di, dj, dist, ux, uy in DIRS:\n            ni, nj = i + di, j + dj\n            if 0 <= ni < gx_n and 0 <= nj < gy_n and safe[nj][ni]:\n                if abs(di) == 2 or abs(dj) == 2:\n                    # check midpoint(s)\n                    mx, my = (i + 0.5 * di) * step_grid, (j + 0.5 * dj) * step_grid\n                    # map to nearest grid cell\n                    if not safe[int(round(my/step_grid))][int(round(mx/step_grid))]:\n                        continue\n                v = nj * gx_n + ni\n                h2 = node_h[nj][ni]\n                # average terrain/slope at midpoint\n                mx, my = (i + 0.5 * di) * step_grid, (j + 0.5 * dj) * step_grid\n                _, gx, gy, code = surf.sample(mx, my)\n                name = TERRAIN_CODES[code]\n                grade = gx * ux + gy * uy\n                slip = slip_mid[name] + slip_gain[name] * (grade if grade > 0.0 else 0.0)\n                if slip > 0.90:\n                    slip = 0.90\n                wheel = dist / (1.0 - slip)\n                t_cost = wheel / 5.0\n                e_cost = wheel * drive_cost[name] + climb_cost * (h2 - h1 if h2 > h1 else 0.0)\n                # Slightly penalize high energy in routing (0.04 ticks per energy unit ~ prefers bedrock/regolith & flat over rocks/climb when time is nearly equal!)\n                w_cost = t_cost + 0.03 * e_cost\n                adj[u].append((v, w_cost, t_cost, e_cost))\n\nt0 = time.time()\npoints = [(\"BASE\", bx, by)] + [(t[\"id\"], t[\"x\"], t[\"y\"]) for t in world[\"targets\"]]\nK = len(points)\npt_nodes = []\nfor name, px, py in points:\n    pi, pj = int(round(px / step_grid)), int(round(py / step_grid))\n    if not safe[pj][pi]:\n        print(\"WARNING unsafe point:\", name, px, py)\n    pt_nodes.append(pj * gx_n + pi)\n\n# Run Dijkstra from all 39 points!\ndist_ticks = [[0.0]*K for _ in range(K)]\ndist_energy = [[0.0]*K for _ in range(K)]\n\nfor idx_s in range(K):\n    src = pt_nodes[idx_s]\n    best_w = [1e9] * N\n    best_t = [0.0] * N\n    best_e = [0.0] * N\n    best_w[src] = 0.0\n    pq = [(0.0, src)]\n    heappop = heapq.heappop\n    heappush = heapq.heappush\n    while pq:\n        w, u = heappop(pq)\n        if w > best_w[u] + 1e-9:\n            continue\n        tu = best_t[u]\n        eu = best_e[u]\n        for v, wc, tc, ec in adj[u]:\n            nw = w + wc\n            if nw < best_w[v]:\n                best_w[v] = nw\n                best_t[v] = tu + tc\n                best_e[v] = eu + ec\n                heappush(pq, (nw, v))\n    for idx_d in range(K):\n        dst = pt_nodes[idx_d]\n        dist_ticks[idx_s][idx_d] = best_t[dst]\n        dist_energy[idx_s][idx_d] = best_e[dst]\n\nprint(f\"All-pairs ({K}x{K}) Dijkstra took {time.time()-t0:.2f}s\")\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/all_pairs.json\", \"w\") as f:\n    json.dump({\"points\": points, \"ticks\": dist_ticks, \"energy\": dist_energy}, f)\nprint(\"Saved /tmp/opencode/all_pairs.json\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/plan_study.py"},"output":"Wrote file {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794710103084,"sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"n2COR2L1F9C5PJDs","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/solve_tour.py","content":"import json\nimport math\nimport random\nimport time\n\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/map0.json\") as f:\n    world = json.load(f)\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/all_pairs.json\") as f:\n    ap = json.load(f)\n\ntargets = world[\"targets\"]\nK = len(targets) + 1  # 0 is BASE, 1..38 are targets\nticks_mat = ap[\"ticks\"]\nener_mat = ap[\"energy\"]\n\n# Add overhead factor for real rover execution (discrete steps, side-slip, curve smoothing, final approach)\n# Let's test both 1.05x and 1.12x travel tick factor + 1.0 tick for sample command itself!\ndef evaluate_sequence(seq, tick_mult=1.10, ener_mult=1.08, eff=0.85, max_tick=418):\n    # Start at BASE (0), first command executes at tick 4!\n    # On ticks 1, 2, 3: idle\n    bat = 100.0\n    for tk in range(1, 4):\n        sol = 2.8 * eff * math.sin(math.pi * (tk + 56) / 532.0)\n        bat = min(100.0, bat + sol) - 0.15\n\n    cur_tick = 3.0  # commands start executing at tick 4\n    cur = 0\n    score = 0.0\n    min_bat = bat\n    details = []\n\n    for idx in seq:\n        t_obj = targets[idx - 1]\n        dt = math.ceil(ticks_mat[cur][idx] * tick_mult)\n        if dt < 1:\n            dt = 1\n        de = ener_mat[cur][idx] * ener_mult\n        e_per_tick = de / dt\n        # Simulate tick by tick for accurate solar capping and min_bat check!\n        for step in range(dt):\n            tk = int(cur_tick) + 1 + step\n            if tk > max_tick:\n                return -1e9, 0.0, details\n            sol = 2.8 * eff * math.sin(math.pi * (tk + 56) / 532.0)\n            bat = min(100.0, bat + sol) - 0.15 - e_per_tick\n            if bat <= 2.0:  # safety floor\n                return -1e9, bat, details\n            if bat < min_bat:\n                min_bat = bat\n        cur_tick += dt\n        # Sample tick:\n        samp_tick = int(cur_tick) + 1\n        if samp_tick > max_tick:\n            return -1e9, min_bat, details\n        sol = 2.8 * eff * math.sin(math.pi * (samp_tick + 56) / 532.0)\n        bat = min(100.0, bat + sol) - 0.15 - 2.0\n        if bat <= 2.0:\n            return -1e9, bat, details\n        if bat < min_bat:\n            min_bat = bat\n        cur_tick = samp_tick\n        dl = t_obj[\"deadline_tick\"]\n        val = t_obj[\"value\"] if (dl is None or samp_tick <= dl) else t_obj[\"late_value\"]\n        score += val\n        details.append((t_obj[\"id\"], samp_tick, dl, val, round(bat, 1)))\n        cur = idx\n\n    # Return to BASE (0)\n    dt = math.ceil(ticks_mat[cur][0] * tick_mult)\n    # Subtract ~0.7 ticks because base_radius is 4.0m!\n    dt = max(1, dt - 1)\n    de = ener_mat[cur][0] * ener_mult\n    if cur_tick + dt > max_tick:\n        return -1e9, min_bat, details\n    e_per_tick = de / dt\n    for step in range(dt):\n        tk = int(cur_tick) + 1 + step\n        sol = 2.8 * eff * math.sin(math.pi * (tk + 56) / 532.0)\n        bat = min(100.0, bat + sol) - 0.15 - e_per_tick\n        if bat <= 2.0:\n            return -1e9, bat, details\n        if bat < min_bat:\n            min_bat = bat\n    cur_tick += dt\n    details.append((\"BASE\", int(cur_tick), max_tick, 0.0, round(bat, 1)))\n    return score, min_bat, details\n\ndef optimize_tour(tick_mult=1.10, ener_mult=1.08, eff=0.85, max_tick=416, iters=60000):\n    rng = random.Random(42)\n    all_ids = list(range(1, K))\n    best_seq = []\n    best_score = 0.0\n\n    # Multi-start SA\n    for restart in range(6):\n        cur_seq = []\n        cur_score = 0.0\n        T0, T1 = 3.0, 0.02\n        steps = iters // 6\n        for s in range(steps):\n            T = T0 * ((T1 / T0) ** (s / steps))\n            cand = list(cur_seq)\n            op = rng.random()\n            if len(cand) == 0 or op < 0.30:\n                # Insert an unvisited target at best or random position\n                rem = [x for x in all_ids if x not in cand]\n                if not rem:\n                    continue\n                x = rng.choice(rem)\n                pos = rng.randint(0, len(cand))\n                cand.insert(pos, x)\n            elif op < 0.50 and len(cand) >= 1:\n                # Remove a target\n                pos = rng.randint(0, len(cand) - 1)\n                cand.pop(pos)\n            elif op < 0.70 and len(cand) >= 1:\n                # Replace one target with an unvisited one\n                rem = [x for x in all_ids if x not in cand]\n                if not rem:\n                    continue\n                pos = rng.randint(0, len(cand) - 1)\n                cand[pos] = rng.choice(rem)\n            elif op < 0.85 and len(cand) >= 2:\n                # Move a target to another position\n                i = rng.randint(0, len(cand) - 1)\n                x = cand.pop(i)\n                j = rng.randint(0, len(cand))\n                cand.insert(j, x)\n            elif len(cand) >= 2:\n                # 2-opt segment reversal\n                i = rng.randint(0, len(cand) - 2)\n                j = rng.randint(i + 1, len(cand) - 1)\n                cand[i:j+1] = reversed(cand[i:j+1])\n            else:\n                continue\n\n            sc, _, _ = evaluate_sequence(cand, tick_mult, ener_mult, eff, max_tick)\n            if sc < 0:\n                continue\n            if sc >= cur_score or rng.random() < math.exp((sc - cur_score) / T):\n                cur_seq = cand\n                cur_score = sc\n                if sc > best_score:\n                    best_score = sc\n                    best_seq = list(cand)\n    return best_seq, best_score\n\nfor eff in [0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 1.00]:\n    t0 = time.time()\n    seq, sc = optimize_tour(tick_mult=1.10, ener_mult=1.08, eff=eff, max_tick=415, iters=60000)\n    _, min_b, det = evaluate_sequence(seq, 1.10, 1.08, eff, 415)\n    print(f\"\\n=== eff={eff:.2f} (took {time.time()-t0:.2f}s): score={sc:.2f}/98.0 ({len(seq)} targets), min_bat={min_b:.1f}, end_tick={det[-1][1]} ===\")\n    for item in det:\n        print(f\"  {item[0]:5s} tick={item[1]:3d} (dl={str(item[2]):>4s}) +{item[3]:4.2f} bat={item[4]:5.1f}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/solve_tour.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/solve_tour.py","time":{"start":1794710103077,"end":1794710103083}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd0ee4220016yMg1E34t1I2pY","sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","messageID":"msg_1dd0e3511001ZOY33cAhHAm51E"}}

* 0.5, margin_m]:\n        for k in range(8):\n            ang = k * math.pi / 4.0\n            offsets.append((r * math.cos(ang), r * math.sin(ang)))\n    for j in range(gy_n):\n        y = j * step_grid\n        if y < margin_m or y > surf.height - margin_m:\n            for i in range(gx_n):\n                safe[j][i] = False\n            continue\n        for i in range(gx_n):\n            x = i * step_grid\n            if x < margin_m or x > surf.width - margin_m:\n                safe[j][i] = False\n                continue\n            for dx, dy in offsets:\n                if         if abs(di) == 2 or abs(dj) == 2:\n                        mx, my = (i + 0.5 * di) * step_grid, (j + 0.5 * dj) * step_grid\n                        if not           if nb >= bat_floor:\n                    cur_tick += 1\n                    bat = nb\n                    if bat < min_bat:\n                        min_bat = bat\n                    break\n                else:\n                    wb = min(100.0, bat + sol) - 0.15\n                    if wb <= bat + 1e-6:\n                        return -1e9, 0.0, 0, 0\n                    cur_tick += 1\n                    bat = wb\n                    waits += 1\n            t_obj = targets[idx - 1]\n            dl = t_obj[\"deadline_tick\"]\n            score += t_obj[\"value\"] if ]\n    best_seq = []\n    best_sc = -1.0\n    for s_idx in range(12):\n        cur_seq = list(seeds[s_idx % len(seeds)])\n        # Trim from end until feasible if infeasible\n        while cur_seq continue\n                x = rng.choice(rem)\n                # Try inserting x at best position!\n                if rng.random() < 0.5:\n                    best_p, best_psc = None, -1e9\n {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794710943952,"sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"epOMrtbIHKA5C7DG","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/check_alt.py","content":"import json\nfrom test_east_loop import eval_seq, id_map, targets, K, dt_fast\n\n# Check NE -> East -> Central -> SE -> Base!\ncand_names = [\n    \"t32\", \"t33\",\n    \"t11\", \"t31\", \"t38\", \"t6\", \"t23\",\n    \"t2\",\n    \"t34\", \"t28\", \"t25\", \"t12\", \"t1\",\n    \"t13\", \"t8\", \"t17\", \"t4\", \"t14\", \"t36\", \"t3\"\n]\nseq = [id_map[x] for x in cand_names]\nfor eff in [0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 1.00]:\n    for ln in range(len(seq), 5, -1):\n        sc, mb, etk, w = eval_seq(seq[:ln], eff=eff)\n        if sc > 0:\n            print(f\"NE+Cent+SE ({ln} tgts) eff={eff:.2f}: sc={sc:.2f}, end={etk}, waits={w} | {' -> '.join(cand_names[:ln])}\")\n            break\n\n# Also check NW first -> SW -> South -> SE -> Central -> Base!\ncand_w = [\n    \"t3\", \"t7\", \"t19\", \"t29\", \"t9\",\n    \"t16\", \"t26\", \"t15\", \"t20\", \"t35\", \"t22\", \"t10\", \"t18\",\n    \"t27\", \"t36\", \"t14\", \"t4\", \"t17\", \"t8\", \"t13\",\n    \"t1\", \"t28\", \"t25\", \"t12\", \"t34\", \"t33\", \"t32\"\n]\nseq_w = [id_map[x] for x in cand_w]\nfor eff in [0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 1.00]:\n    for ln in range(len(seq_w), 5, -1):\n        sc, mb, etk, w = eval_seq(seq_w[:ln], eff=eff)\n        if sc > 0:\n            print(f\"NW+SW+SE+Cent ({ln} tgts) eff={eff:.2f}: sc={sc:.2f}, end={etk}, waits={w}\")\n            break\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/check_alt.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/check_alt.py","time":{"start":1794710943948,"end":1794710943951}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd1bb8c9001DZH2qhUQS5cdia","sessionID":"ses_e22f614a5ffe3QwZCrQ7ruhZBc","messageID":"msg_1dd1acb67001Isvj0AW44Jol1n"}}
